nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.eicab.brain_mask¶

Brain mask from TotalSegmentator for qvtpy venous centerline filtering.

Runs total_mr on Angiography_3D with ROI subset brain, using qvtpy-configured TotalSegmentator model roots (see nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.config).
